service.en: Register a vehicle in the Abu Dhabi toll system (Darb)
service.ar: تسجيل مركبة في نظام التعرفة المرورية درب
service.ur: ابوظہبی ٹول سسٹم (درب) میں گاڑی کی رجسٹریشن
service.ml: അബുദാബി ടോൾ സംവിധാനത്തിൽ (ദർബ്) വാഹനം രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്യൽ

about: Register a vehicle, from Abu Dhabi or another emirate, in the Darb toll gate system.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
